blocks.goal: Reduce CompilationUnit's output coupling by extracting printing-related responsibilities (Printer, ConfigurablePrinter, PrinterConfiguration) into a new helper class so CompilationUnit no longer directly depends on those types.

ops.details: Move the three printing-related methods (printer(Printer), getPrinter(), getPrinter(PrinterConfiguration)) out of CompilationUnit into a new class com.github.javaparser.ast.CompilationUnitPrinter. The new class will encapsulate direct use of Printer, ConfigurablePrinter and PrinterConfiguration. Replace the moved methods in CompilationUnit with thin delegating methods that forward to an instance of CompilationUnitPrinter (created lazily or injected). This removes direct references to Printer, ConfigurablePrinter and PrinterConfiguration from CompilationUnit's implementation (they remain in the new class).

outputs: javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/CompilationUnit.java (imports updated: remove direct Printer/ConfigurablePrinter/PrinterConfiguration imports, add import for com.github.javaparser.ast.CompilationUnitPrinter)
ops.details: Remove Printer, ConfigurablePrinter and PrinterConfiguration imports from CompilationUnit; add import for the new helper class. Add imports needed by the new class (Printer, ConfigurablePrinter, PrinterConfiguration) there.

outputs: CompilationUnit methods now delegate to CompilationUnitPrinter; internal call sites updated where necessary
ops.details: Update internal calls in CompilationUnit (if any) to call the delegating methods or the new helper as appropriate. External callers of public methods keep the same signatures (delegation preserves API).

blocks.goal: Reduce CompilationUnit's output coupling by extracting token/position range recalculation (JavaToken, Position, TokenRange, Range and EOF usage) into a dedicated helper, removing those direct type dependencies from CompilationUnit.

ops.details: Move the recalculatePositions() method into a new helper class com.github.javaparser.ast.CompilationUnitPositionRecalculator. The new class will perform the iteration over JavaToken, use EOF/range/Position and set ranges on tokens. In CompilationUnit replace recalculatePositions() with a delegating call (e.g. new CompilationUnitPositionRecalculator(this).recalculatePositions()). This removes direct references to JavaToken, Position, TokenRange (and the static imports for EOF and range) from CompilationUnit.

outputs: javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/CompilationUnit.java (remove imports/static imports used only by recalculatePositions)
javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/CompilationUnitPositionRecalculator.java (add imports/static imports for JavaToken, Position, Range, EOF)
ops.details: Remove JavaToken/Position/Range related imports (and static imports EOF, range) from CompilationUnit and add them to the new helper's imports. The new helper will depend on TokenRange access via the CompilationUnit API (it will call compilationUnit.getTokenRange()).

outputs: CompilationUnit delegating method and any internal direct usages updated to call the helper
ops.details: Ensure the public API remains the same (CompilationUnit.recalculatePositions() exists but delegates to the new helper). No external API signature change occurs.
